articles.title: Tennessee fined $500K after fans storm field following win over Alabama
articles.summary: The Southeastern Conference fined Tennessee $500,000 on Sunday for allowing fans to storm the field following a 26-10 victory over then-No. 6 Alabama.

articles.title: How did Tennessee's defense dictate the win against Alabama?
articles.summary: After forcing the No. 6 Crimson Tide to their second fewest yards in three seasons, SEC Now's Chris Doering and Benjamin Watson break down how the No. 14 Vols won defensively.

articles.title: Miami rises to No. 1, Texas and Alabama plummet in latest AP poll
articles.summary: Fourteen ranked college football teams lost in Week 7, with five of them being in the AP poll's top eight. Here’s what you need to know about the latest AP Top 25 Poll.

articles.title: Auburn upsets No. 1 Georgia with walk-off field goal
articles.summary: For the first time since October 1990, the No. 1 team in the country has lost in back-to-back weeks. No. 1 Georgia is the latest top-ranked team to fall after Auburn made a 34-yard field goal to win 27-24.

articles.title: Hagan, Basketball Hall of Famer and Kentucky legend, dies at 94
articles.summary: Hall of Fame forward Cliff Hagan, a five-time All-Star who spent his entire NBA career with the St. Louis Hawks, has died at age 94.

articles.title: Florida's Todd Golden: NCAA eligibility chaos self-inflicted
articles.summary: Florida coach Todd Golden says the chaos of college eligibility is caused by the NCAA.

articles.title: Mark Pope embracing championship expectations at Kentucky
articles.summary: Kentucky men's basketball coach Mark Pope said he is embracing championship expectations entering Year 3 with the Wildcats.

articles.title: John Calipari takes questions on development of young Razorbacks
articles.summary: Calipari takes the podium at SEC Tipoff '27 to break down how Arkansas has put in the work to improve over the offseason and what to expect from talented youngsters.

articles.title: Chris Jans details confidence in MS State, transfer portal pandemonium
articles.summary: Jans explains the challenges coaches are experiencing from the rules, or lack thereof, in college sports while saying the Bulldogs learned a lot to get better from last season.

articles.title: SEC in filing: LSU dispute remains 'live,' school lacks institutional control
articles.summary: The SEC is opposing LSU's request to dismiss the conference's lawsuit against the university and its officials, saying a live controversy still exists between the parties.

articles.title: Missouri coach to attend Mark Mitchell eligibility ruling
articles.summary: Missouri basketball coach Dennis Gates will support Mark Mitchell in court Wednesday as the two-time All-SEC selection seeks a fifth season of eligibility.

articles.title: RJ Luis Jr. one of several not on LSU's roster amid eligibility concerns
articles.summary: Amid eligibility concerns, RJ Luis Jr. -- who had previously signed two contracts with NBA teams -- was not listed as a member of LSU's 2026-27 basketball team.

articles.title: Georgia rises to No. 1, LSU and Oregon fall in latest AP Top 25 college football rankings
articles.summary: Here’s what you need to know about the latest college football AP Top 25 Poll.

articles.title: Oklahoma stuns No. 1 Texas in a Red River Rivalry thriller
articles.summary: Oklahoma stunned No. 1 Texas, 27-24, winning its biggest game of the season and shocking the top-ranked team in the country with a game-winning field goal. It's the first Red River Rivalry win for OU since 2023.

articles.title: South Carolina, North Carolina, UCLA and Kentucky pull off top-25 upsets in Week 6
articles.summary: There’s a lot of benefits that come with being a Top 25 team, but immunity isn’t one of them.

articles.title: Ahmed Nur commits to Ole Miss for school's top recruit in decades
articles.summary: Top-20 senior Ahmed Nur has committed to Ole Miss, giving the Rebels their highest-ranked recruit in at least 20 years.
